_comment: Provenance of gymbo-sentence-rulings.json. That file is VENDORED VERBATIM from content's sentence-level log-verb rulings in the Gymbo-v1 repo; never hand-edit it. Re-vendor = a new content ruling + a new commit + a new sha256 here, in one change. scripts/check-log-verb.mjs fails if the file's sha256 differs from this record. WHAT THIS DOES NOT PROTECT: the file and this record can be edited together in ONE PR and the gate accepts it (tester, PR 222). The only defence against that is a DRIFT ORDER that compares the file to the LIVE bead comments by running content's docs/rulings/vendor_sentence_rulings.py --verify (exit 1 = divergence, exit 2 = could not verify; both must file a bead). THAT ORDER DOES NOT EXIST YET. It is owed by pm, who creates it now that the file is on Gymbo-v1 main (tracked on gy-uu7mt). Until it exists this gap is documented, not defended. The file is only as current as content's last refresh.
